what: QA's own pre-run review of this harness (five reviewers, one skeptic each), made on the harness at a9ff602 and its working changes before the freeze; every confirmed finding was fixed in f972176 or 3002218 unless the report says otherwise

findings.finding: Evidence writer aborts on every subscription run: the redaction check trips on the app's own hint text and on the harness's own step text
The real-turn gate is a reusable boolean: nothing mechanical stops a second invocation from pressing Ask again
OS click and keystrokes are not bound to the checked window at the moment they are sent
The subask branch never checks that the run used the real, un-overridden connector: a stand-in's account passes a turn.* check
Redaction safety net misses the shapes the runner actually produces (nested JSON strings), and has no test for an address, e-mail or raw base64
Raise() on the overlay removes its always-on-top state
Local hygiene of the stand-in folder and of copied private files
Evidence writing always aborts: the redaction guard trips on the app's own section text ("password") and on the driver's own step text ("data:image")
The runner executes subcheck's osClick and keys steps as `window` steps (nothing is clicked or typed), and run.completed still says each step was its planned step
The process watch counts every process whose working folder is inside the root as the connector; release() and subcheck's 'started on the press' can fail or pass on unrelated processes
control.off_by_default_and_nothing_before_check passes with no watcher evidence at all, and the clock-free evidence (kids_*) is collected but never judged
Several control notes claim more than their conditions test (unbound answer 'not kept', cancel, Stop's late answer, 'sends nothing')
qa.never_signs_in: the planned-step pattern misses a double-quoted getElementById("subLogin").click()
Windows-stamp against WSL-stamp comparisons use a fixed 2 s tolerance and no measured offset
The harness waits 170 s for the answer and then closes the card, which cancels a real turn the app would still wait up to 300 s for
Fifteen steps after the one press are still required; one failing read aborts the run and the analyzer then cannot judge an answered turn
Only an environment variable guards the one attempt; an error-looking exit after the press allows a second real submission
At HEAD nothing checks, between the selection and the press, that the picture to be sent is the surface with two solid rings
analyze_sub.py stops while writing evidence: its picture-data guard matches the `data:image` literal in every planned askRead step
The work folder is removed in `finally` even when evidence copying threw before the asks and receipts were copied
Sign-in, model and form are checked once, about 35 steps before the press, and not again at the press
The 'explain' prompt tells the model not to reveal 'the problem's final answer', which is what the question asks for
The process watch counts every process whose working folder is inside QA_SUB_BACKEND, so a shared checkout fails the release check
subcheck: the OS click and both key steps never run (the runner takes them as plain `window` steps), and the analyzer reports that as a product observation
Real scenarios watch the whole Backend checkout: any unrelated process whose working folder is inside it fails check.connection_read and release
Evidence export aborts in every sub scenario: the harness's own step text contains 'data:image'
`--backend <path>` without an evidence folder makes the Backend checkout the evidence folder
A turn that did not complete is reported as 'the receipt does not match the kept request'; an abort before Ask is reported as a question that 'ended as None'
turn.no_leak_of_the_truth passes on a recomputed prompt that is not shown to be the one sent, and can fail on the app's own card text
turn.provenance_on_the_card is a substring test that small numbers always satisfy
check.no_question_and_no_receipt cannot fail on its receipt half; the signed_out note claims an unchecked button
Receipt check: item types by a deny-list that misses 10 of the connector's types, no assistant message required, and the model is not compared with the chosen one
The analyzer raises on an unreadable selection record or a missing picture file
Judge: a colour or shape outside the vocabulary counts as 'not stated'; some correct answers are 'contradicted' and the analyzer then says the cards were not named
'Started only on the press' rests on two clocks with a 2 s tolerance; clock-free evidence the run collects is never read
Additional, not in the list: the worktree was edited by someone else during this review, and one intermediate state made a perfect real turn fail
The form that "never became ready" is a released-app race, not Check connection: the harness only aborts on it and its probe tests the wrong cause
The real connector is configured with codex_bin null, but under wsl.exe --exec codex is not on PATH: Check would say "unavailable"
The analyzer still requires assistance "explain" while the driver now asks the real question with "full_solution" by default
The typed-text check sends letters through SendKeys on a Chinese-language Windows: an active input method would turn them into a false "a user cannot type" fail
